text: 1. Application form. 2. A copy of a valid passport, including name, passport number, expiration date, and photo. 3. A photo consistent with the passport of the applicant. 4. A copy of high school graduation certificate: A notarized copy is also required if it is in a text other than Chinese or English. 5. High school transcript. 6. Certificate for English proficiency , such as IELTS or TOEFL scores, only for Non-English native speakers. 7. A copy of visa: Only for students who are already in China. 8. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit relevant legal documents from their legal guardians in China.. 9. A copy of the Physical Examination Form for Foreigners within its validity period of 6 months . 10. A certificate of no criminal record within its validity period of 6 months. 11. A life photo of the full body taken within 3 months and a full-body video in 10 seconds. 12. Talents in art, sports, and other fields are preferred. Please provide certificates or performance videos.
